description: Fix P0-1: D3 VERIFIED semantics. D3 currently marks blocks VERIFIED based only on hasRenderer and assumes documented: true for all implemented blocks. This does not prove TutorialBlockRenderer registration, UBRC compliance, test coverage, or runtime verification. Distinguish five states (IMPLEMENTED, RENDERED, REGISTERED, TESTED, VERIFIED), remove documented assumption, require actual evidence for VERIFIED status. Update snapshot contract and all affected tests.
steps: 1. Read d3-blocks-scanner.ts crossReferenceBlocks function (lines 256-294). Current logic: `const isVerified = hasRenderer; verified.push({ documented: true, implemented: true, rendered: hasRenderer, tested: false })`. This assumes documented: true without proof.

2. Change line 287 documented field: remove assumption. Set `documented: false` by default. Only set `documented: true` if block version appears in documented array (doc.versions includes impl.version). Requires cross-referencing documented array.

3. Update crossReferenceBlocks signature to accept documented: BlockFamilyDoc[] parameter. Pass it from scanBlocks caller (line 131). Update function call: `const verifiedBlocks = crossReferenceBlocks(implemented, rendered, documented);`

4. Inside crossReferenceBlocks, build map of documented versions: `const documentedVersions = new Set<string>(); for (const doc of documented) { for (const v of doc.versions) documentedVersions.add(v); }`
5. For each impl in implemented, check: `const isDocumented = impl.version !== undefined && documentedVersions.has(impl.version);`

6. Update VERIFIED criteria comment (lines 278-282): Change from 'VERIFIED = type + renderer + UBRC' to 'VERIFIED = documented + type definition + renderer + registered in TutorialBlockRenderer + UBRC compliant + test coverage'. Add note: 'Current implementation checks documented + type + renderer. REGISTERED, UBRC, TESTED checks require additional scanner phases (future work).'

7. Update isVerified logic: `const isVerified = isDocumented && hasRenderer;` Only mark verified if BOTH documented and rendered. Remove incompleteBlocks exclusion (S1) — instead, these should naturally not be verified if they lack documentation or renderer.
8. Update BlockVerification object: `documented: isDocumented, implemented: true, rendered: hasRenderer, tested: false`. Remove blanket documented: true assumption.

9. Add comment documenting 5-state model: '// Block states: DOCUMENTED (in registry), IMPLEMENTED (type def), RENDERED (component exists), REGISTERED (in TutorialBlockRenderer registry), TESTED (test coverage). VERIFIED requires all 5, but REGISTERED check is future work.'

10. Update __tests__/unit/d3-blocks-scanner.test.ts test 'should maintain 4 separate block states': rename to 'should maintain separate block states (documented, implemented, rendered, verified)'. Update assertions to verify documented field is not assumed true for all.

11. Add test case: 'should mark block as verified only when documented AND rendered'. Mock documented array with I1, mock implemented with I1, mock rendered with introduction component. Assert verified includes I1 with documented: true. Mock implemented with O1 (not in documented), assert verified does not include O1 or includes it with documented: false.

12. Update integration test test-d3-d6.ts line 104-107 assertion: 'D3: 3 verified blocks (I1, C1, D1)' may now fail if any of these are not in documented array. Verify actual documented registry content, adjust expected count if needed based on actual documented state.

13. If snapshot.ts BlockVerification interface needs updates (e.g., adding 'registered' field for future), add it as optional: `registered?: boolean;` with comment '// Future: check TutorialBlockRenderer registration'. Do NOT implement the check yet, just prepare the contract.

14. Update D3 scanner JSDoc comment (lines 16-22) to clarify that VERIFIED is not just 'type + renderer' but requires documented proof: 'VERIFIED: Cross-referenced complete implementations (documented + type + renderer). Future: add REGISTERED (in renderer registry) and TESTED (test coverage) checks.'
acceptance_criteria: D3 scanner no longer assumes documented: true for all implemented blocks
BlockVerification.documented field reflects actual presence in documented array, not assumption
Verified blocks require BOTH documented: true AND rendered: true (hasRenderer check)
Tests verify that undocumented blocks are not marked verified or have documented: false
Integration test test-d3-d6.ts passes (may need expected count adjustment)

Run node packages/project-llm-discovery/__tests__/integration/test-d3-d6.ts — verified block count matches actual documented+rendered state, exits 0
